approved_entries: .venv/bin/python -c "import sqlite3,tempfile,os,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from freight_recon.schema import create_canonical_schema; p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'probe.sqlite3'); c=sqlite3.connect(p); create_canonical_schema(c); print(sorted(r[0] for r in c.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type='table'\")))"

reasons: a idempotency scenario asserts something about whether an effect durably happened, but inspects no persisted state. An HTTP status or a local response is not evidence that the underlying outcome occurred.
scenario carries no usable provenance, so nothing records why it exists: run/task identity (task_hash), generation stage, generation source (model or session_id)
scenario records generation wave 0, but waves are numbered from 1; an unnumbered wave cannot be located in the run
unsupported external navigation: url 'https://example.com/admin' addresses 'example.com', which is not loopback. Scenarios operate the locally running product and never produce an external effect.
